bibliographic.title: That Sink
bibliographic.author: Andrew Stephens
bibliographic.description:
The whole weekend lies before you. But first - breakfast!

Unfortunately, your kitchen appliances have disappeared. All of them. Plus your vacuum cleaner.

What can be behind this turn of events? Does your neighbor Jeb or his shaggy dog Toby know anything about it? What is that sound coming from the old well? And what shocking secrets are hiding down at the lake?

That Sink was first published as an entry in the 2026 InkJam with the theme Let That Sink In. It is a short game of gentle humor.
